issues.on_page: Public works 151,151 (Street Fund 145,534 + General Fund cemetery 5,617)
issues.issue: Public works includes 5,617 of cemetery spending (p8 lists Cemetery under Public works); streets/highways is defensible for the line as a whole but the cemetery portion is not street spending

cemetery operating expenses categorized streets/highways because p8 groups Cemetery under Public works; the cemetery is not a street function, so a cemetery/general government category could also be argued
mixed label covers repairs and supplies; Repairs and Maintenance is a judgment call (Supplies and Materials equally defensible)
the page does not say this is a payment to another entity; it may be the village's own senior center operating cost
